title: Define statement AST nodes
description: These frozen dataclasses represent Mini statements, blocks, and complete programs.

steps.description: LetStmt and AssignStmt each store a name and expression value.
FunDef stores a function name, parameter tuple, and block body.
ReturnStmt and PrintStmt each hold the expression they process.
IfStmt stores its condition, then block, and optional else block. WhileStmt stores its condition and body.
ExprStmt wraps an expression as a statement. Block and Program hold tuples of statements.
